name: Canola

attributes.attribute: drew music from sinews on a whale’s ribs

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Canola is an Irish heroine. The harp, today a mark of Ireland, owes its origin to this woman. One night a quarrel with her lover sent her walking until dawn. At the shore she caught a sweet melody, and its spell made her sleep under the open sky. On waking she traced the music to whale sinews that still hung from the ribs, set ringing by the breeze. The sight moved her to craft the earliest harp.

okr.objective: Canola is the legendary maker of the Irish harp.
key_results: The harp is a sign of Ireland.
She heard music from sinews on a whale’s ribs.
Her find led to the first harp.
